draft: The sun peers through smog, casting an amber glow on towering buildings in a city on edge. People rush by, faces etched with worry as they navigate blocked roads, sporadic protests, military patrols, and curfews. Slogans for unity and stability adorn government buildings, but dissenting voices vanish amidst targeted audits. Markets are tense, infrastructure strained under shifting climates and growing populations. Yet mutual aid networks, open negotiations in markets, and resilient canals offer a flicker of hope. Life goes on under the watchful eye of the state and skies.
